description.en: DSH bundles from the AItelier repository.
description.zh: 来自 AItelier 仓库的 DSH 插件包。

description.en: A resident director that turns tasks into reviewed todo plans, hands each plan to a native DSH worker, checks what it delivered, and sleeps when nothing is left; or a steward you talk to, which keeps your memory. The built-in local host keeps everything in plain files: no server, no database. Install it into a profile of its own; the profile's patch names the root directory and the model.
description.zh: 常驻导演：把任务冻结成经过审阅的待办计划，交给 DSH 原生工作者执行，核对交付结果，无事可做时休眠；也可作为与你对话、保存你的记忆的管家。内置的本地宿主把一切保存在普通文件里：无需服务器，无需数据库。请装进一个专用的配置档（profile），并在该配置档的补丁里写明根目录和模型。
